name: La Cadena Rota: Supply Chain Basics
description: Three-round introductory simulation teaching supply chain fundamentals through ProteínaCo S.A.S., a Colombian protein supplement manufacturer. Students manage demand forecasting, inventory decisions, supplier selection, and logistics trade-offs while experiencing the Bullwhip Effect, EOQ principles, and Total Cost of Ownership in an Andean manufacturing context.
